title: Case 041: Pallet delivery lacks a receiving-dock appointment

details.data: Entirely synthetic; English; fictional geography; all times UTC

context: The pallet is booked for a business consignee whose warehouse requires a receiving-dock appointment. Carrier and consignee must use the same reference and time.
initial_request: Please book with authorised receiving coordinator Ossa Rell. Obtain the dock reference, time and receiving entrance for our driver.
overview: The escalation snapshot comprises history events 001–002. Event 003 records the next agent action; the subsequent events provide the disclosed calibration follow-through. Facts learned later must not be used as if already known at escalation.

next_action.summary: Contact the consignee's receiving coordinator to book an available dock slot.

outcome: The consignee and carrier confirm the same appointment reference and time.
boundaries: An appointment reference establishes coordinated booking, not pallet receipt.

events.body: Pallet DL-041 for Arcloom Components has no receiving appointment. We can reach its dock on 2026-03-15 afternoon, but will not send the truck without a consignee appointment.
Please book with authorised receiving coordinator Ossa Rell. Obtain the dock reference, time and receiving entrance for our driver.
Please offer an available receiving-dock appointment for pallet DL-041 on 2026-03-15 afternoon, with dock reference and entrance.
Appointment ARC-041 is reserved for 2026-03-15, 14:00–15:00 UTC at dock D3. Our receiving team will be staffed for this slot.
We accept ARC-041, 2026-03-15 14:00–15:00 UTC, dock D3, for DL-041. The carrier booking and consignee appointment now match; delivery has not occurred.
